task_summary: Customer seeks warranty repair for a malfunctioning PowerBlend Mini Blender purchased under order ORD-6032. The correct procedure is to verify warranty eligibility, review the warranty policy, present a preview to the customer, obtain confirmation, and then file the claim in accordance with the policy.

Agent must review warranty policy before filing a warranty claim.
Agent must make a process_warranty_claim preview tool call for WRT-4013 with confirm false or omitted before making the confirm=true process_warranty_claim tool call.
